summary: Expiry is only evaluated when a link is loaded into the Caffeine cache (ShortenerService.loadActiveLink). The cached CachedLink already carries expiresAt, but resolve() never consults it, so a link that expires while cached keeps redirecting until its cache entry expires.
risks: CreateRateLimitFilter only matches POST /api/v1/urls exactly, so a new bulk endpoint would bypass the per-client create limit
The existing test ExpiryDefectTest asserts the buggy behaviour and must be replaced with one asserting the fix
expires_at has no index; harmless today but relevant to expiry lookups
suspectedRootCause: ShortenerService.resolve returns the cached CachedLink without re-checking CachedLink.expiresAt() against the clock.
